core.guard: Enemies must attack this unit before any other unit or the hero.
core.swift: This unit may attack the turn it is played (no summoning sickness).
core.endure: The first time this unit would take damage, prevent it. The shield is then consumed.
core.foresee: Look at the top X cards of your deck; put them back in any order or send them to the bottom.
core.discover: Choose one of three offered cards (from your deck unless the card says otherwise).
core.arrival: An effect that happens when this card is played from hand (battlecry).
core.legacy: An effect that happens when this unit dies (deathrattle).
core.fulfill: A condition on a Legendary that, once met, transforms it into its fulfilled form (see CLAUDE.md 6).

classSignatures.redeem: Shepherd. When this (small) ally dies, return it to the field or summon a Sheep, as specified.
classSignatures.covenant: Patriarch. Triggers at the start of each of your turns.
classSignatures.scatter: Disciple. When this unit dies, summon a 1/1 Disciple.
classSignatures.raise: Priest. Return or revive a fallen ally, as specified.
classSignatures.giant_slayer: Warrior (card-specific). Destroys units with 4+ attack that it strikes, and takes no counter-damage.

cardTypes.minion: A unit with attack/health that occupies a board slot (max 7).
cardTypes.spell: A one-time effect, then discarded. Epic/legendary spells are flavored as 'Miracles'.
cardTypes.relic: A persistent artifact. relicKind 'equip' attaches to a unit; 'standing' is a global permanent.

notes: Do not invent new keywords without human sign-off (CLAUDE.md 5). Prefer expressing new effects with the existing effect-verb library (CLAUDE.md 8).
